# NetworkCentralityMetrics

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Graph-theoretic measures (e.g., degree, betweenness, eigenvector centrality) used to identify nodes with disproportionate influence on epidemic spread. Guides targeted quarantine decisions in TCC systems, optimizing resource allocation for threat containment in large-scale interconnect networks.
